messages:
emma.r: FYI I hit a small but reproducible bug: when our Go SDK generator reconnects during an auth refresh, the client sees a couple tokens duplicated. Minimal repro below.

alex.p: Ugh. Short snippet + logs?

emma.r: Snippet: `gen, _ := client.Generate(ctx, req); for gen.Next() { fmt.Print(gen.Token()) }`
Log: `stream: resume seq=30` then `emit seq=29 token="hello"` -> duplicate 29.

kevin.h: Likely overlap semantics: client asked resume from lastSeen inclusive and server replays inclusive. Two immediate fixes: client-side dedupe (needs seq metadata) or server-side opaque resume token to avoid overlap.

sophie.t: For DX keep ergonomics: propose adding opt-in `WithResumeStrategy(Exclusive)` and expose `Generator.ResumeToken()` as an opaque string. Default behavior unchanged.

emma.r: I'll open a tiny repro and WIP PR with tests and a sampleapp showing the opt-in.

alex.p: Thanks, team. Please add a short ADR for server resume semantics so eng-runtime can implement deterministic behavior.
